Decision Model Leaderboard

Open and hosted decision models (typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out), scored on the community Decision Index 0.2.1
 suite.

About this leaderboard

Source. All non-Cloudflare results, the benchmark suite and the scoring formula come from the original Jev Decision Index on Hugging Face, maintained by multimodalart and contributors.
Coverage. This is not an exhaustive list of decision models. It shows only the models currently scored in the Decision Index, plus Cloudflare's Clef models; other community models may not appear here.
Self-reported. Clef and Clef-flash were run by Cloudflare, the models' authors, and have not been reproduced by the upstream board. See Methodology.

Methodology
Scope

This page reproduces the community Decision Index 0.2.1 leaderboard and adds self-reported entries. It is not an exhaustive list of decision models: it covers only the models currently scored in the Decision Index, plus Cloudflare's Clef models. Every community result is taken unchanged from the upstream board's published data (snapshot 28 September 2026). The index formula is re-implemented here and checked against every upstream model's published score at build time; the build fails if any disagree.

Self-reported entries

Entries marked Self-reported were run by the model's authors on the same benchmark suite and have not been reproduced by the upstream maintainers. Benchmarks an entry did not run are scored 0, following the upstream rule that unanswered requests count as wrong. Their latency was measured on the authors' own serving stack, not the upstream reference hardware (1 x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000), and is not directly comparable.

Scoring

Each benchmark score s is corrected for chance level c, so random guessing scores 0 and a perfect answer scores 1:

k = clip((s − c) / (1 − c))

ForecastBench (Brier loss) is converted as clip((0.25 − Brier) / 0.25). Each area is the weighted mean of its benchmarks, with gold ★ benchmarks weighted 1.2. The Decision Index is 100 × the weighted mean of the five areas.

Acknowledgements

The benchmark suite, chance levels, area weights and all community results are the work of the Decision Index 0.2.1 maintainers and contributors. This page is unofficial and is not affiliated with them or with TypeSafe.
